comment: Documented vertical-slice wiring gaps tolerated by tools/client_vertical_wiring_audit.py. Every entry is a half-wired gameplay feature: P0 = core vanilla path broken, P1 = real feature gap, P2 = unused/low-priority channel. The gate fails on any NEW unwired item; an entry whose item becomes wired is reported as a stale waiver and must be removed.
